name: ActionML Harness (Universal Recommender)

vendor.backing: OSS (Apache-2.0); ActionML is the commercial sponsor offering paid support/consulting around the OSS server
vendor.hq: USA (San Francisco Bay Area; ActionML, LLC)
vendor.status: effectively dormant / minimally maintained. Latest stable is harness-0.7.0; Docker Hub image actionml/harness 'last updated almost 5 years ago' with newest visible tag develop-2021-09-06. Repo not archived but no recent release activity. Universal Recommender lineage traces to Apache PredictionIO (retired/attic).
vendor.scale: Docker Hub actionml/harness shows 1M+ pulls; GitHub ~293 stars / ~49 forks. The predecessor stack (PredictionIO + Universal Recommender template) had far wider historical adoption in e-commerce recommendation.

ports: 27017/tcp (MongoDB backing store - host-mapped in default compose)
9200/tcp (Elasticsearch model/index store - host-mapped in default compose)

verification_primitive.probe: GET http://<host>:9090/system  (and GET /engines). Read-only. If auth is enabled these return 401 with a Bearer WWW-Authenticate challenge; if open they return 200 with JSON.
verification_primitive.success_signal: HTTP 200 with a JSON body from /system (server/version info) and a JSON array from /engines listing engine instances, served with 'Server: akka-http' header. 200 + engine JSON = auth disabled and instance is open.
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: Confirms unauthenticated access to the recommender control plane: attacker can enumerate every engine, read engine configs, read per-user behavioral data via /engines/{id}/entities/{userId}, inject/poison events via POST /events, run queries to exfiltrate the item catalog and relationships, trigger training jobs (Spark compute abuse), and delete engines. Stop at the GET (names/configs are the finding); do not exercise writes/deletes.

endpoints.returns: System/version info JSON (handler getSystemInfo). Unauth read of server identity when auth disabled.
Health check 200 (handler healthCheck). Good unauth liveness probe.
JSON list of all configured engine instances (handler getEngines) - enumerates every deployed recommender/engine on the server.
JSON config/status of a specific engine (handler getEngine) - reveals engine type and configuration.
Creates a new engine from a posted JSON config (createEngine). On an open instance this is a write/admin action.
Deletes an engine (deleteEngine) - destructive when unauth.
Returns stored data for a given user/entity (getUserData) - reads per-user behavioral data.
Ingests a behavioral event (write). Open instance accepts arbitrary event injection / model poisoning.
Returns recommendations for a query (read of model output, can enumerate item catalog/relations).
Starts a training job (updateEngineWithTrain) - triggers Spark compute.
Runs a batch-train command (CommandsRouter) - no per-route auth directive in source.
Bare HTTP 200 with empty body (CheckRouter root route). No HTML/UI/welcome string - Harness is a headless REST API.
